name: 📊 count badge: the host's box-sizing applies
why: On springsteenlyrics.com (Bootstrap: border-box everywhere) the widest count's badge grew past the shared min-width, so its label sat further right (vzell, 2026-11-05: "(176) Live").

name: window dot: the site source does not say what it has read
why: _dpWinRead() asked _mbPop only; a detail site keeps its pages in _dpMem, so an SL song read by its card never got the dot (vzell, 2026-11-05).

name: window dot: a card's answer does not re-mark the window
why: Only MusicBrainz's read-ahead re-marked the window; a card's answer landing after the pointer left marked nothing.
